# uem_mac_application (Resource)

Uploads a macOS application to Workspace ONE UEM. This resource handles the full upload workflow: uploading the file as a blob,



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_version` (String) Application version string (e.g., "2.6.22")
- `dmg_file_path` (String) Path to the DMG file on disk
- `org_group_id` (Number) Organization Group ID (integer) where the file will be created
- `plist_file_path` (String) Path to the plist (pkginfo) XML file describing app metadata

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The internal ID assigned by UEM after creation
- `uuid` (String) The internal UUID assigned by UEM after creation
